commits.edited_message: Bound GetDataSlab copies to selected columns

coupling: The base copied the complete numeric array for a partial column slab. The first edited maintenance commit repairs that by allowing contiguous full-column slices while copying only their selected byte count. The later rank-N indexing refactor retains that wider rank-2 fast path but passes the entire source byte count to memcpy. With the original first commit, the later full-size copy is restricted to the complete array; with only the first edit, partial slices use the selected size. The repair must reconcile the earlier fast-path selection contract with the later copy length. A compressed cell child reaches this in-memory path through Mat_VarReadData.
